description: This file is a Python script that sets up a Streamlit-based web app integrating a language model and SQL database for a chatbot interface. It includes environment configuration, database connection, LLM and agent setup, a prompt template for user queries, and a main function for the chat interface.

methods.name: count_tokens
methods.description: A function that combines a prompt template with a user query, runs it through a chain, and returns the result while tracking token usage.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main function that runs the Streamlit app, handling user input, displaying chat messages, and invoking the token counting function.
